glosses: to split, to split something up

examples.translation: This piece of wood is split.
examples.english: This piece of wood is split.

glosses: to split oneself up, to be in different places or perform several activities at the same time

examples.text: Ich kann mich doch nicht zersprageln.
examples.translation: I can't be in different places at the same time.
examples.english: I can't be in different places at the same time.

glosses: to labour, to struggle, to wear out, to work oneself into the ground

examples.text: Ich habe mich für die Firma zerspragelt.
examples.translation: I've worked myself into the ground for the company.
examples.english: I've worked myself into the ground for the company.
